name: Hadal-Cirque
description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around massive canyon systems, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.
Toxic air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Trade at the smuggler cache changes hands often and quietly. Its current occupants deal fuel for silence and ask no questions about cargo.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on geothermal energy, iron and exotic matter are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
